descriptions.zh: 您在删除指定EIAM应用时，请确保对应应用已经不再使用，应用删除后所有配置数据都将被删除，无法进行恢复。
descriptions.en: Before deleting a specified EIAM application, make sure the application is no longer in use. After the application is deleted, all configuration data is permanently deleted and cannot be recovered.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun eiam delete-application --instance-id idaas_ue2jvisn35ea5lmthk267xxxxx --application-id app_mkv7rgt4d7i4u7zqtzev2mxxxx --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun eiam DeleteApplication --region cn-hangzhou --InstanceId idaas_ue2jvisn35ea5lmthk267xxxxx --ApplicationId app_mkv7rgt4d7i4u7zqtzev2mxxxx
